brief: Kiln, a booking app for small ceramics studios
title: Kiln
purpose: Sell Kiln to small ceramics studios
layers: Logo "Kiln"; links Studios, Classes, Pricing; button "Book a wheel".
Headline "Fill every wheel, every week." Subline "Kiln handles bookings, waitlists and kiln schedules so you can stay at the wheel." Buttons "Start free", "See a studio".
"Used by 140 studios": Mudroom, Slip & Co, Earthbound, The Wheelhouse, Clayground.
Title "Spreadsheets were never a booking system." Three pains: double-booked wheels, no-shows nobody chases, kiln loads tracked on paper.
Title "Bookings that fill themselves." Members book wheels and classes from their phone; the waitlist moves up when someone cancels.
Title "Kiln loads, scheduled." Each firing: bisque or glaze, cone, shelf space left, whose pieces are in it.
92% fewer no-shows; 6 hours saved a week; 31% more class revenue. Caption "Averages across studios after 3 months."
1 Add your wheels and kilns. 2 Share your booking link. 3 Watch the calendar fill.
"We stopped losing Saturdays to no-shows." Ana Ruiz, owner, Mudroom Ceramics.
Studio $39/month: 4 wheels, waitlists. Collective $89/month: 12 wheels, kiln schedule, class packs.
Can members pay in the app? Yes, by card. Do you take a fee per booking? No. Can I import my spreadsheet? Yes, a CSV.
